seoDescription: How international buyers can source manufactured products from Tamil Nadu, India. Submit technical RFQs for supplier identification and quotation coordination.

hero.title: Source Directly from Tamil Nadu Manufacturers
hero.subtitle: We help international brands, importers, and procurement directors discover verified industrial and consumer product suppliers across Tamil Nadu, India.

benefits.title: Why International Buyers Work with Us
benefits.b1Text: We interpret your product specifications, CAD drawings, and tech packs so local factory engineers understand exact requirements.
benefits.b2Text: We evaluate manufacturing facilities on location, verifying operational status, machinery, and production history.
benefits.b3Text: Receive direct, itemized factory quotes without middleman hidden markups. We charge an agreed coordination fee.
benefits.b4Text: From lab dips and golden samples to third-party quality inspections and Tuticorin/Chennai port logistics.

rfqSection.title: Submit Your Sourcing Brief
rfqSection.subtitle: Complete our 4-step sourcing request with your product specifications, quantities, and delivery requirements.
